gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: He spoke so quietly that the jury couldn't hear him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for the jury to hear him.
gaps.explanation: so quietly that nobody could hear = too quietly (for anybody) to hear.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading books to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.
